title: Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass coverage
content: The pass covers reserved seats on the Sanyo Shinkansen between Shin-Osaka and Hiroshima, eligible JR-West conventional services in the valid area, and the JR West Miyajima Ferry. It does not cover the Tokaido Shinkansen between Shin-Osaka and Tokyo, the Sanyo Shinkansen Hiroshima↔Hakata, or the Kyushu Shinkansen Hakata↔Kagoshima-Chuo.
